A license holder who is required to register his or her business or apply for permits with the department may change his or her registered business provided that such change is disclosed to the department in a manner required by the department and where:
   1.   All business documentation required by the department, including new insurance certificates, for the new business is submitted;
   2.   All open applications filed by the license holder under the previous business are closed or transferred; and
   3.   All fines, penalties or fees owed to the city or department related to the work performed by the previous registered business during the period the license holder was registered at that business are paid.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
